description:
Query enhancer-gene regulatory interactions from ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, and other sources and save to parquet file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table interval — one record = one regulatory interval linked to one gene in one biosample by one source.
Key: chromosome, start, end, geneId, intervalType, datasourceId, biosampleName (biosampleName may be null).
Arguments: gene_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc within datasourceId (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown start, end, score, distanceToTss are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Enhancer-to-gene and promoter intervals of OT 25.09; absence means no interval in these sources.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: gene_id, chromosome.

datasourceId.description: Results are listed per datasourceId; pass one value to restrict them.

gene_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

max_distance_to_tss.description: Keeps rows with distanceToTss |x| <= this value (compared on the absolute value); unknown values never pass.

min_score.description: Keeps rows with score >= this value; unknown values never pass.
